description: E-Survey of Road Users' Attitudes is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Vias Institute. The E-Survey of Road Users' Attitudes (ESRA) collects road safety performance and road safety culture data. The main themes covered in the survey include: self-declared behaviour, attitudes and opinions on unsafe traffic behaviour, enforcement experiences and support for policy measures. The data collected for Australia is compared against the average of 39 nations participating in the survey. Coverage is Australia with international comparisons, 2016 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: PDF (3 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
